title: EZ-Restaurant — Scan. Order. Enjoy. AI-Powered Restaurant SaaS Platform
summary: EZ-Restaurant is a next-generation AI-powered QR ordering and restaurant management platform. Featuring real-time WebSocket order syncing, interactive Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), digital waiter bells, and Google Gemini AI dish recommendations, EZ-Restaurant redefines hospitality efficiency and customer satisfaction.
challenge: Traditional restaurant operations suffered from slow waiter response times, physical menu printing costs, ordering errors, lack of real-time kitchen visibility, and high app download friction for diners.
solution: AiKodX engineered a high-performance Turborepo monorepo using Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and Google Gemini AI. Diners scan table-specific QR codes for contactless ordering, live dish tracking (Received → Preparing → Ready → Delivered), digital waiter calling, and AI culinary advice. Kitchen staff utilize a real-time KDS with sound alerts, while restaurant owners gain Recharts sales analytics, menu CRUD controls, and table QR code generators.

title: MSG — Luxury Ethnic Wear E-Commerce & Merchant OS
summary: MSG is a custom-built, full-stack E-Commerce platform tailored for high-end luxury ladies' ethnic wear (Sarees, Salwar Suits, Lehengas, Kurtis, and Dupattas). Styled in Royal Matte Crimson Red (#9B1B30) & Antique Gold (#D4AF37), it bridges traditional retail charm with digital-first convenience via a high-performance Customer Storefront and intuitive Merchant Management Dashboard.
challenge: Traditional boutique retailers often struggle with standard off-the-shelf e-commerce platforms that lack local fulfillment flexibility (such as reserve-in-store options) and fail to reflect the premium aesthetic required for luxury ethnic fashion.
solution: AiKodX Studio engineered a lightweight, ultra-fast e-commerce engine customized specifically for luxury ladies' ethnic apparel. We combined a regal aesthetic with sophisticated merchant management features, enabling seamlessly coordinated online sales, in-store pickups, and automated inventory tracking.

title: AI Studio — Accelerate Innovation with Gemini 2.0 Flash Powered Intelligence
summary: AI Studio is a cutting-edge web application designed by AiKodX to provide users with a fast, modern, and interactive interface for Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash AI model. It provides real-time answers, writes complex code snippets, formats technical markdown, and persists chat sessions.
challenge: Existing AI model wrappers often suffer from bloated bundle sizes, slow response rendering, poor mobile responsiveness, lack of syntax highlighting, and lost prompt history upon page refreshes.
solution: AiKodX engineered a ultra-fast React 19 + Vite 7 SPA connected directly to the Google Gemini 2.0 Flash API endpoint. Built with Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion drawers, Dracula code syntax highlighting, custom regex heading polishers, and 30-session localStorage history persistence.

title: ReadyGo — Intercity Ride Sharing & Proximity Hub Matching Platform
summary: ReadyGo is an intercity ride-sharing platform that connects drivers offering empty seats with passengers traveling along similar routes. Built around a 50km hub proximity geofence, ReadyGo optimizes long-distance travel and commuting efficiency.
challenge: Single-occupancy intercity driving creates traffic congestion, high fuel costs, and carbon waste, while passengers lack direct, affordable, and flexible regional commute options.
solution: AiKodX engineered a dual-portal ride-sharing web system powered by MySQL transactional storage and 50km radius hub matching. Drivers publish vacant seat offers in seconds, while passengers query matching origin-destination pairs with direct driver contact details and hotline support.

title: Dropizi Courier — Next-Gen Hub-Based Parcel Delivery System
summary: Dropizi Courier is an end-to-end hub-based parcel delivery platform that leverages a 50km radius geofencing algorithm to route packages efficiently between regional hubs and intercity courier routes.
challenge: Legacy courier dispatching systems suffered from high last-mile delivery costs, lack of regional hub relay optimization, manual package sorting delays, and poor parcel tracking visibility.
solution: AiKodX engineered a full-stack logistics SaaS platform powered by Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and 50km hub geofence routing. Dropizi enables automated parcel manifests, live hub-to-hub tracking, acoustic arrival alerts, and seamless driver dispatch portals.
